chunks: When the sky is split asunder,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the sky is split asunder in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted not merely as a physical tearing but as the unveiling of the divine reality (Haqq) and the removal of the veil of worldly illusion. It establishes the cosmic backdrop for the accountability of deeds, emphasizing that the dissolution of the heavens precedes the individual reckoning where every soul will witness its own record.
